title: Person swap
makes: An existing video re-filmed with another person or character in it: same room, same product, same movements.
needs: a swap GPU connected with set_5090.py --swap, running swap/box/queue.sh
the claude command-line tool (the suitability check)
a Fish Audio key (only for a new voice)

ask_first.ask: Who goes into it? A picture of the person or character.
Is this your own video, or has its creator agreed to this?
ask_first.why: A swap copies someone's video. Without one of these two answers it is not made.

ask_first.ask: Keep the original voice, or have a new voice say the same words?

steps.title: Check and cut the video
steps.say: Whether the video suits a swap, and how long the swap will take.

steps.title: Bring it back
steps.say: Run again every few minutes until it is finished.
